verdict.rationale: Cline ships an official CLI. It installs via `npm install -g cline` and supports interactive terminal sessions and headless automation for CI/CD. The docs show concrete invocations: `--auto-approve`, piping `git diff` into cline, and @file references. They also cover cron scheduling through the hub, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI itself (community comments discuss Cline generally, not the CLI).
